description: This Java class represents configuration settings for a merchant system, including display options and search configurations, with JSON serialization capabilities.

classes.name: MerchantConfig
classes.description: A Java class that stores merchant system configuration options, supports JSON serialization, and implements Serializable for object persistence.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the configuration data into a JSON string.

methods.name: setDisplayCustomerSection
methods.description: Sets whether the customer section is displayed.

methods.name: isDisplayCustomerSection
methods.description: Returns whether the customer section is displayed.

methods.name: setDisplayContactUs
methods.description: Sets whether the 'Contact Us' section is displayed.

methods.name: isDisplayContactUs
methods.description: Returns whether the 'Contact Us' section is displayed.

methods.name: setDisplayStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets whether the store address is displayed.

methods.name: isDisplayStoreAddress
methods.description: Returns whether the store address is displayed.

methods.name: setUseDefaultSearchConfig
methods.description: Sets the map for default search configurations.

methods.name: getUseDefaultSearchConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the map for default search configurations.

methods.name: setDefaultSearchConfigPath
methods.description: Sets the map for default search configuration paths.

methods.name: getDefaultSearchConfigPath
methods.description: Retrieves the map for default search configuration paths.

methods.name: setDisplayAddToCartOnFeaturedItems
methods.description: Sets whether to display 'Add to Cart' on featured items.

methods.name: isDisplayAddToCartOnFeaturedItems
methods.description: Returns whether 'Add to Cart' is displayed on featured items.
